name: Bluetooth (HC-05)
author: Bench Workshop
description: The HC-05 Bluetooth serial module: whatever a phone sends comes out of its TXD as serial bytes, and whatever the board sends to its RXD goes to the phone. The phone is in the run panel: type a line and Send. Use SoftwareSerial or Serial1/Serial2.

parts.name: Bluetooth HC-05
parts.description: VCC (3.6-6 V), GND, TXD to the board's RX, RXD to the board's TX (RXD takes 3.3 V: from a 5 V board, use a divider), STATE is high while a phone is connected. 9600 baud unless you change it in its settings. The run panel has the phone: connect it, type, Send.

examples.name: Phone switches an LED
examples.description: Type on and off on the phone (the HC-05's card in the run panel): the board switches its LED and answers. The HC-05 is on Serial1 (GP0/GP1).
